meta.description: Add, register, edit, list, show, or validate a Proteina-Complexa design target for any pipeline — protein binder (default), ligand binder, or AME/enzyme scaffolding. Use when user wants add target, define new target for binder design, register hotspot, set up PDL1 binder target, ligand binder pocket, SMILES target, AME task, enzyme motif, complexa target add/show, configure target X, what targets available, where hotspots live, target_input meaning, chain-spec syntax, binder length range, or questions about targets_dict.yaml, ligand_targets_dict.yaml, ame_dict_v2.yaml.

recommendations.title: Add rollback guidance for incorrect edits
recommendations.problem: Reliability 2.3 scored 11/12; no explicit undo/rollback strategy if user saves incorrect target definition. Backup exists (.yaml.bak) but recovery not documented.
recommendations.root_cause: File edit preferred but recovery from edit errors not covered.
recommendations.fix: Add to troubleshooting: To rollback incorrect target, restore from .yaml.bak (created automatically on save) or use git checkout configs/targets/targets_dict.yaml if committed. For CLI adds, re-run with --force and corrected fields.

recommendations.title: Improve AME task coverage
recommendations.problem: Agent-Specific scored 13/20; AME tasks marked as 'Partial' support with file-edit-only and hand-curated contig_atoms. Less structured than protein/ligand paths.
recommendations.root_cause: AME schema extended and CLI does not support it.
recommendations.fix: Add reference/ame_schema.md with contig_atoms grammar, worked examples, and atom selection guidance. Current note in Step 1 is brief for complex schema.
